description: Look up live US import tariff rates by HS code or product keyword (e.g. 8703.24, laptop, steel pipe). Returns base MFN rate, 2026 China-stacked Section 301 rate, EU rate, MPF/HMF fees and a landed-cost example. Call this first for any tariff question, then use tariff.export for the raw schedule.

query.description: HS code (e.g. '8703.24') or product keyword (e.g. 'laptop', 'steel pipe'). Free-text is fine; being specific improves precision. Example: '8703.24'.

name: tariff.lookup
